source_row.rationale: ACC/AHA guidance specifies a target INR of 3.0 for a mechanical mitral valve replacement. Option B is correct. Other mechanical valves may have different targets, which is why the stem specifies the mitral position. The other numeric targets do not match the guideline target for this valve position.
source_row.source_detail: Prosthetic-valve antithrombotic therapy: mechanical mitral valve replacement requires vitamin K antagonist anticoagulation with a target INR of 3.0; targets differ for mechanical aortic valves/risk profiles. 2020 ACC/AHA Valvular Heart Disease guideline remains the current ACC/AHA valve guideline in 2026; next major update is anticipated in 2027; currentness live-rechecked 2026-08-15. NCSBN first-check: Client Needs — Physiological Integrity — Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies: medication administration, adverse effects/interactions, reversal, monitoring and teaching. 2026 NCLEX-RN Test Plan; effective 2026-04-01 through 2029-03-31; currentness rechecked 2026-08-15.
